# A query is a box the store holds, found by an id and the key it was asked
# with, and `remote.query` is an ordinary intrinsic an adapter calls — there is
# no query construct and no mark. So what reaches the output is whatever the
# inliner carried to the call site, which is where the box has to be keyed.
#
# `&` is the caller's whole say in it. The url as a value keys one question
# forever, so the box is bound once and stays where it was put; the url as a
# cell is a question that follows its source, so the lookup moves to the read
# and the ordinary dependency walk re-evaluates it.

sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out snap snap.sngl
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out live live.sngl

# Both are the same lookup, keyed by the same url, under the id the adapter
# spelled — and inside the thunk, the transport the language implements, down
# to the Go package that performs the request.
grep 'remote\.Query\[Result\]' snap/model.go
grep '"http\.fetch"' snap/model.go
grep '\[\]string\{m\.url\}' snap/model.go
grep 'http\.Get\(m\.url\)' snap/model.go

# The value: bound once, in the constructor. Changing the url after that is not
# a new question, because the caller did not ask for one.
grep 'm\.res = remote\.Query' snap/model.go

# The cell: not stored at all. A box bound once never re-keys however often its
# url changes, so the lookup is what every read of `res` becomes — and a
# re-evaluated lookup with a different key starts a fetch.
! grep 'm\.res = remote\.Query' live/model.go
! grep 'res ' live/model.go
grep 'remote\.Query\[Result\]\(remote\.Default, "http\.fetch", \(\[\]any\)\(\[\]string\{m\.url\}\)' live/model.go

# Neither carries a ref: a pointer into a model the platform copies is not
# something a backend can be handed.
! grep '&m\.url' live/model.go

-- snap.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"
import http "sngl:remote/http"

component main {
    var url = "https://example.com/"
    var res = http.fetch(url)

    window(title="fetch") {
        text(value=res.or(blank).body)
        button(text="go", @click { url = "https://other/" })
    }
}

const blank = http.Result{status=0, body="", headers={}}

output(lang="go", platform="bubbletea")
-- live.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"
import http "sngl:remote/http"

component main {
    var url = "https://example.com/"
    var res = http.fetch(&url)

    window(title="fetch") {
        text(value=res.or(blank).body)
        button(text="go", @click { url = "https://other/" })
    }
}

const blank = http.Result{status=0, body="", headers={}}

output(lang="go", platform="bubbletea")
